mapper.select: SELECT e.* FROM collaboration_room_entry e WHERE e.delivery_state IN ('queued','selected') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM collaboration_room_entry ahead WHERE ahead.enterprise_id=e.enterprise_id AND ahead.room_id=e.room_id AND ahead.recipient_agent_id=e.recipient_agent_id AND (ahead.delivery_state='selected' AND e.delivery_state='queued' OR ahead.delivery_state=e.delivery_state AND ahead.queue_position < e.queue_position)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM collaboration_participant p JOIN collaboration_work_item w ON w.enterprise_id=p.enterprise_id AND w.participant_id=p.id WHERE p.enterprise_id=e.enterprise_id AND p.web_room_id=e.room_id AND p.agent_id=e.recipient_agent_id AND w.active_run_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM collaboration_room_entry s JOIN collaboration_task t ON t.enterprise_id=s.enterprise_id AND t.id=s.task_id JOIN collaboration_work_item w ON w.enterprise_id=t.enterprise_id AND w.id=t.owner_work_id WHERE s.enterprise_id=e.enterprise_id AND s.room_id=e.room_id AND s.recipient_agent_id=e.recipient_agent_id AND s.delivery_state='starting' AND w.status='ready') AND (e.delivery_state='selected' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM collaboration_task t JOIN collaboration_work_item w ON w.enterprise_id=t.enterprise_id AND w.id=t.owner_work_id JOIN collaboration_participant p ON p.enterprise_id=t.enterprise_id AND p.id=w.participant_id WHERE t.enterprise_id=e.enterprise_id AND t.id=e.task_id AND p.agent_id=e.recipient_agent_id AND w.status='ready' AND w.run_round=0 AND t.status='active')) ORDER BY e.updated_at,e.id LIMIT #{limit}
